title: Feedback-Driven Prompt Refinement for Educational AI: Affective Trajectory Estimation and Bloom's Taxonomy Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.28293v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contribution: This study has shown that a shared prompt-refinement procedure, guided by distinct affective and cognitive feedback signals, can improve held-out reference agreement and multi-label classification while reducing affective-generation variability without executor parameter updates. Background: Industry 4.0 has increased demand for personalized technical education across interconnected computing and engineering domains, while prompt sensitivity and generation variability have complicated dependable interpretation of instructional dialogue and learning outcomes. Research Questions: The study has examined whether task-specific feedback can improve affective-reference agreement, generation consistency, and cognitive classification without updating executor parameters. translated_title: 面向教育人工智能的反馈驱动提示词优化：情感轨迹估计与布鲁姆分类法分类
translated_abstract: 贡献：本研究表明，一种由不同情感和认知反馈信号引导的共享提示词优化程序，能够在不更新执行器参数的情况下，提高对留出参考的一致性和多标签分类性能，同时降低情感生成的不稳定性。背景：工业4.0增加了对互联计算与工程领域个性化技术教育的需求，而提示词敏感性和生成不稳定性使得对教学对话和学习成果的可靠解读变得复杂。研究问题：本研究探讨了任务特定的反馈能否在不更新执行器参数的情况下，提高情感参考一致性、生成一致性和认知分类性能。方法：一个次级语言模型利用执行器输出与模型生成的情感参考之间的差异来修订执行器提示词，应用于四个对话……
tldr: 本研究提出一种由情感与认知反馈信号驱动的共享提示词优化方法，无需更新模型参数即可提升教育AI的情感轨迹估计与布鲁姆分类性能，并降低情感生成的不稳定性。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that a shared prompt-refinement procedure guided by distinct affective and cognitive feedback signals improves reference agreement and Bloom's taxonomy classification while reducing affective generation variability, all without updating executor model parameters.
